children: LME copper (MCU3=LX) may retest a support at $14,051 per metric ton, a break below which could trigger a drop into the $13,654-$13,804 range.
The metal approached the support again after a decent bounce. This move indicates an incomplete wave c from $14,699, which may extend below its 100% projection level of $14,050.
A bearish wedge will be confirmed if the metal breaks $14,051. Resistance is at $14,375, a break above which may lead to a gain into the $14,527 to $14,699 range.
* The copper report is published weekly on Monday.
